blocks.plainText: For parcels within the blocks bounded by West 50th Street, Tenth Avenue, West 56th Street and Eleventh Avenue, within a general large-scale development that occupies zoning lots on more than one block, the City Planning Commission may permit the modification of open space required pursuant to Section 23-732 (Floor area and open space ratios in R6 through R9 Districts), as part of a special permit, pursuant to Section 74-743 (Special provisions for bulk modification), provided the Commission finds that:

blocks.html:
